title: Implement Find Replaceable Types And Designs For Pieces In Design
description: Implement findReplaceableTypesAndDesignsForPiecesInDesign algorithm across all languages (TypeScript, Go, Python, Rust, C#). The algorithm suggests replaceable types/designs for selected pieces based on port compatibility of their connections.
summary: Implemented connector-valid piece alternatives in compose/rs by adding PieceStore::alternatives(), alternative_types(), and alternative_designs(), backed by a design-level candidate matcher that only returns replacement kinds and designs whose free connectors can satisfy the selected piece boundary requirements without creating an invalid design. Extended the existing Rust test module with focused alternatives coverage for empty selections, isolated pieces, boundary multiplicity, piece-method behavior, and shared synthetic replaceability cases. Fixed the algorithms Storybook replaceability story to call the existing JS kit-level operation with the actual port catalog input, and fixed a duplicate Kit import in Delete.stories.tsx that was blocking the algorithms build. Verified with cargo test --manifest-path compose/rs/Cargo.toml (90 passed), cargo test --manifest-path compose/rs/Cargo.toml alternatives:: -- --nocapture (5 passed), npm test in compose/algorithms (no test files, exit 0), and npm run build in compose/algorithms (Storybook build completed successfully).
